'''Corran Antillies Who says WYS has to be all smugglers''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Corran Antillies]]
* '''Published:''' 11 December 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Watch Your Step
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS8 WYS Antillies LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Krayt Dragon Howl (V), Rayc Ryjerd (V), Princess Leia Organa (V), Master Luke (V), Lobot (V), Chewie (V), The Signal (V), Surreptitious Glance (V), I Must Be Allowed To Speak (V), Luke's Blaster Pistol (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

A deck I played at a tourney where all decks had to play at least 8 v8 cards.

The published list has 61 cards.

The post starts 'AUAOf + 10 sheilds'; none are named.

== Notes ==

* Qty 61 as published (the Characters header says 18 and matches; the other sections have no counts).
* Virtual Set 8 evidence: the description says the tournament required 'at least 8 v8 cards'. Dested to VS8: Krayt Dragon Howl (V), Princess Leia Organa (V) x2, Master Luke (V) x2, The Signal (V), I Must Be Allowed To Speak (V), Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) - eight cards, matching the rule.
* Posted 'Chewie v' left as posted (UNKNOWN): Chewie (V) has no printing legal by Dec 2004 (VS10 only); candidates are Chewbacca (V) (VS3) or Chewbacca, Protector (V) (VS7).
* Posted Rayc V dested Rayc Ryjerd (V) (VS5); Ben Kenobi (at Cantina) is a starting character; Insurrection is the single Effect.
* Original-era printing corrected: Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Set 8) -> Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Set 6) (an earlier dest had linked the modern virtual card of the same name).

== Strategy ==

This is a very fun deck to play.  You set up Obiwan at Cantina for a first turn drain of three which rocks.  If they come after obiwan and kill him, Houjix him and no big deal.  Drop Luke or a raider on a pt craft to the db and either signal, tunnel vision, or speak for cellebration and throw somebody down on tatooine to cellebrate.  There are lots of little tricks with this deck.  Strangle with leia if they play bounty hunters which was pretty common at the v8 tourney.  Once you get out the other two DBs w/ Insurrection, you can do some serious retrieval with cellebration.  The other thing is to do a few late game kessel runs.  For ground defense, my all time favorite combo if they ambush you at one of the dbs.  Play Fallen Portal then OOS for Lobot v, then Lobot v for Lando.  Though it rarely works more than once per game, it turns an ambush into a masacre.
